title: Test Edit
description: Start here to learn about our community expectations.
content:
ACCOUNT RULES
1. No Alt Abuse - Use of alts to take advantage of server rewards.
2. No Inappropriate Skin/Username - Keep it family friendly.
3. No Login Attempt - Trying to login other's username account on their own IP will be counted as another alt under your IP. And we are not responsible for that if you reach 3 accounts per IP.

SOCIAL RULES
1. No Toxicity - Harassment, profanity, personal attacks, discrimination, threats, and intentional harm.
2. No Doxxing - Sharing private personal information without consent.
3. No Advertising - Do not promote other servers, communities, products/services.
4. No Impersonation - Do not pretend to be staff, streamers, or any other players.
5. No Foreign Language - In public chat, only use English/Tagalog.
6. No False Report - Do not fabricate evidence to target others.
7. No Malicious Links or Files - Phishing links, malware, and harmful downloads.
8. No Public Drama - Avoid public arguments, for their only purpose is to drag everyone in. Seek assistance to resolve it. If it's outside of our server? It's on you to fix it. Don't drag us in. Learn to confront directly.
9. No Inappropriate Context - Any form of message, item renames, nicknames, image of NSFW, sexually explicit, excessively graphic, or otherwise inappropriate content is prohibited.
10. No Excessive Begging - Begging for items/ranks/access is prohibited. If a player/staff says no and still insists after being declined 3 times, it is punishable.

title: Land CLaims
description: A beginner-friendly introduction to the server.
content:
How to claim?
1. Get a Golden Shovel or /kit claim.
2. Right-click one corner of the area on the ground.
3. Walk diagonally to the opposite corner and right-click the ground.

How to resize claim?
1. Hold the Golden Shovel.
2. Right-click any existing corner block of your claim.
3. Walk to the new position and right-click the ground to stretch or shrink the area.

How to get more claims?
1. Buy blocks! Type /buyclaimblocks <amount> to buy extra blocks with money.
2. Claimblocks crate! You need a key obtainable from vote crate, pinata crate, and afk crate.

Make separate claims?
- Use your Golden Shovel on an unclaimed area to make another claim as long as you have remaining claim blocks.

Commands?
- /claim - Claims the area around you using your available claim blocks.
- /abandonclaim - Deletes the claim you are currently standing inside.
- /abandonallclaims - Deletes every single claim you own.
- /claimslist - Shows your claim block balance and lists all your claim locations.
- /trust <player> - Gives someone full permission to build and access everything in your claim.
- /containertrust <player> - Allows someone to use chests, furnaces, animals, and doors, but NOT build.
- /accesstrust <player> - Allows someone to only use doors, levers, buttons, and beds.
- /permissiontrust <player> - Grants someone permission to give other players access to your claim.
- /untrust <player> - Revokes all access permissions from that player.
- /untrust all - Clears every single player from your claim's trust list.
- /trustlist - Shows every player currently trusted in your claim.
- /subdivideclaims - Switches your shovel to sub-claim mode to create private rooms/plots inside a main claim.
- /basicclaims - Switches your shovel back to normal land claiming mode.
- /trapped - Teleports you out if you get stuck inside someone else's claim.
- /claimexplosions - Toggles whether TNT and Creeper damage work inside your claim.
- /givepet <player> - Transfers ownership of a tamed dog, cat, or horse to someone else.
- /unlockdrops - Lets other players pick up your items if you die.
- /buyclaimblocks <amount> - Purchases additional claim blocks using server money.
- /sellclaimblocks <amount> - Sells your unused claim blocks back for server money.
